subject: [PATCH v3 8/8] nfsd: raise delegated time floors after a size-changing SETATTR

2026-11-09.patch_summary: This patch addresses an issue in the NFSv4 server where a size-changing SETATTR operation does not update the delegated time floors (dl_mtime and dl_ctime) correctly. When a timestamp delegation's stateid is used, the patch ensures that the c/mtime set by the size change is recorded in the delegation's attributes. This prevents stale holder times from moving the timestamps backward and avoids repeated CB_GETATTR replies. The patch fixes a bug introduced by a previous commit (6ae30d6eb26b) and adds support for delegated timestamps.
